meta.title: About the Club
meta.description: Established March 1, 2016, the Burnaby Entrepreneurs Toastmasters Club is a supportive community in Metrotown, Burnaby BC.

page_hero.headline: A supportive room in Metrotown
page_hero.intro: Established March 1, 2016. Chartered by Toastmasters International. Meeting every Wednesday in Metrotown, Burnaby.

headline: A supportive room in Metrotown
lead: Established on March 1, 2016, The Burnaby Entrepreneurs Toastmasters Club in Metrotown is a supportive community tor people who want to build confidence in communication, public speaking, and leadership.
second: With an entrepreneurial mindset, our club welcomes business owners, professionals, creatives, and anyone looking to speak with more clarity and authority. Through mentorship, peer feedback, and hands-on practice, members grow their skills, build meaningful connections, and turn goals into action.
callout_lead: Entrepreneurial-minded people. You don't need to be an entrepreneur.
callout_sub: For people who want to build a network with entrepreneurs.

extras.heading: How the club started
extras.body: The club was chartered on March 1, 2016 by a small group of Metrotown-area business owners who wanted a communication practice space of their own. It has met every Wednesday since.

extras.heading: Toastmasters International
extras.body: We are a member club of Toastmasters International, a non-profit that has helped people improve their communication and leadership skills since 1924. Members work through the Pathways learning path at their own pace.
